name: Authentication Exchange
description: The authentication exchange — the login/sign-in flow, OAuth2/OIDC handshake, SAML assertion, or token-issuance dialog — carrying credentials, codes, and tokens between clients, the identity provider, and services. The path over which a principal proves identity. The place to look for the auth handshake, login flow, token issuance, SSO/federation exchange, or credential-and-token traffic during sign-in.
